name: black_mic
description: Use your phone as a high-quality wireless microphone for Linux — lossless PCM over WebSocket into a system-wide virtual PipeWire device.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.lint:server: node --check server.js && for f in server/*.js; do node --check "$f"; done
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test:unit

author: Black Mic Studio contributors
